summary.prose: Building this Story changes four places that together decide how small work is tracked: the ISSUE record learns to describe a change, the issue-approval advance carries the ISSUE's hash forward, the build refuses work without an ISSUE, and triage sends trivial work to the issue stage. The agent-facing text is updated to match. A new repair step then gives the 16 existing trivial builds an ISSUE and lets the completion rule settle their Stories.

tasks.title: Record and render an ISSUE's kind
tasks.summary: Add optional meta.kind ('defect' | 'change') to IssueArtifact; finalizeIssue stores params.kind beside magnitude and refuses an unknown value; renderIssueMarkdown uses What was asked / Why / Change for 'change'; the issue.capture prompt asks for a change's request and reason when the run's kind is 'change'.
acceptanceChecks: An issue run with params.kind 'change' stores meta.kind 'change'; an unknown kind writes no ISSUE.
An ISSUE with no kind renders byte-identically to before.
A change ISSUE renders What was asked, Why and Change.

tests.name: finalizeIssue: params.kind change is stored on the ISSUE meta and an unknown kind is refused
renderIssueMarkdown: kind change renders What was asked, Why and Change
renderIssueMarkdown: an ISSUE with no kind renders byte-identically to before
issue capture prompt: a change run asks what was asked and why, not for a defect

tasks.title: Hand the ISSUE's hash to the next stage
tasks.summary: nextAfterIssue puts issue.meta.issueHash in the small build call (standalone.epicHash) and the sized design.story call (params.epicHash), and refuses an ISSUE without a 16-hex issueHash.
acceptanceChecks: A small ISSUE's advance call carries standalone.epicHash equal to the ISSUE hash.
A sized ISSUE's advance call carries params.epicHash equal to the ISSUE hash.
An ISSUE without a valid issueHash makes the advance fail.

tests.name: nextAfterIssue: a small ISSUE routes to build with the ISSUE hash as standalone.epicHash
nextAfterIssue: a sized ISSUE routes to design.story with params.epicHash set to the ISSUE hash
nextAfterIssue: an ISSUE without a 16-hex issueHash is refused

tasks.title: Refuse a headless no-design build
tasks.summary: The standalone no-LLD build stops minting a hash from the focus: implement and validate refuse a call without epicHash (no-identity) or whose epicHash has no approved ISSUE (no-head). Small (LLD) builds are unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: A no-LLD call without epicHash is refused with no-identity and writes nothing.
A no-LLD call whose epicHash has no approved ISSUE is refused.
A no-LLD call under an approved ISSUE builds as before.

tests.name: build implement: a no-LLD standalone call without epicHash is refused with no-identity and writes nothing
build implement: a no-LLD standalone call whose epicHash has no approved ISSUE is refused

tasks.title: Route trivial work to the issue stage
tasks.summary: routeForSizeClass('trivial') returns startStage 'issue'; buildNextCall starts the issue workflow with sizeClass trivial, magnitude small, kind change (and kind defect for a bugfix); no tier starts at build.
acceptanceChecks: Triage of a trivial request returns an issue-workflow nextCall with kind change and magnitude small.
No size class routes to build.
A trivial change runs issue, approval, build and BUILD approval and its Story completes.

tests.name: routeForSizeClass: trivial routes to the issue stage with no LLD
routeForSizeClass: no tier starts at build
triage nextCall: trivial starts the issue workflow with sizeClass trivial, magnitude small and kind change
a trivial change: ISSUE approved, build under its hash, BUILD approved completes STORY and EPIC

tasks.title: Update the steering and tool descriptions
tasks.summary: Steering block lines 231, 341-342, 463, 536 and 557 and the insrc_build_step / insrc_triage descriptions say trivial work and a small bugfix start with an ISSUE and that the code-review packet pins it; refresh the plugin asset copy.
acceptanceChecks: No steering or tool description routes trivial work straight to build or calls a BUILD record a ledger entry.

tests.name: the steering text routes trivial work through the issue stage and no longer calls a BUILD record a ledger entry

tasks.title: Backfill rule: preview and ISSUE write
tasks.summary: Add the repair rule and step 'backfill-issue' before 'units': the preview lists one change per standalone trivial BUILD with no DEF, ISSUE or LLD head; repair writes a kind 'change' ISSUE under the BUILD's hash from its focus, triage rationale and summary, anchored at its epicCreatedAt, approved by the migration actor with the reason recorded, or left pending when the BUILD is not approved. Each write is reported under 'backfill-issue'.
acceptanceChecks: repair-preview lists one backfill-issue change per headless BUILD and writes nothing.
repair writes the ISSUEs; a second run lists none.
The ISSUE of a BUILD that is not approved stays pending.

tests.name: repair-preview lists one backfill-issue change per headless standalone trivial BUILD and writes nothing
repair writes a kind change ISSUE for each headless BUILD, approved by the migration actor, and a second repair lists none

tasks.title: Settle backfilled Stories and recover a part-way run
tasks.summary: Prove that after the backfill the existing units and settle steps complete, hold or leave unsettled each Story by the completion rule, and that a failure during the backfill is reported and finished by the next run. Post-deploy (not code): back up the records, run repair-preview on this repository, expect 16 backfill-issue changes, then run repair and read written, held and failed.
acceptanceChecks: Settle completes a backfilled Story with a qualifying approval, holds one approved before the cutoff without an override, and leaves the draft BUILD's Story unsettled.
A part-way failure lists what was written and the next run finishes without writing any ISSUE twice.

tests.name: repair settles a backfilled Story by the completion rule: one completes, one approved before the cutoff without an override is held, and a draft BUILD is not settled
a failure injected during the backfill lists the ISSUEs written and the next repair writes only the rest
